tools.name: unit_price
tools.description: Cheapest listings matching a product description, priced per unit (per ml, per diaper, per page, per lb) with the pack size and the gap to that category's median. Use for "what should X cost" and "is this a good price".

tools.name: category_price
tools.description: Median cost per unit for one category, with the 25th-percentile "good price" threshold and the 75th above which a buyer is overpaying. Call with no known slug to get the list of categories.

tools.name: bigger_pack
tools.description: For one listing, the same product in a materially different pack size that costs less per unit, and by what percentage. Takes a deal slug as returned by unit_price.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "unit_price" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
